# Patched dependencies

Copies of two charmbracelet modules with performance fixes, and of Gio with a fix for a lost
Wayland display, wired in by the `replace` block in go.mod. Tests and testdata are stripped
(Gio's flake files too); licenses kept. Drop each copy once upstream releases the fix.

| Module | Version copied | Patch | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| github.com/charmbracelet/ultraviolet | v0.0.0-20261008173134-6b8d4baf91b4 | `Buffer.InsertLineArea` / `DeleteLineArea`: for full-width areas, rotate the row slices instead of copying every cell | scrolling no longer costs width × height cell copies per line |
| github.com/charmbracelet/x/vt | v0.1.0 | `Scrollback.Push`: drop the oldest line by reslicing instead of `slices.Delete` | a full scrollback no longer shifts 10k lines per pushed line |
| github.com/charmbracelet/x/vt | v0.1.0 | `Emulator.Resize`: a shorter main screen scrolls its top lines into the scrollback first | shrinking a pane keeps the prompt on screen instead of cutting off the bottom lines |
| github.com/charmbracelet/x/vt | v0.1.0 | Soft wraps and reflow (reflow.go): autowrap marks the row it leaves (`Screen.wrap`, `Scrollback.wrap`; erasing to a row's end drops the mark; `Wrapped`, `ScrollbackWrapped`); a width change of the main screen joins the marked rows into lines and wraps them again, scrollback included, the cursor kept in its line and on its row (`ResizeMap` says where old positions went); a wide character that doesn't fit, or ends on the last column, wraps whole. Tests in `reflow_test.go` | a pane laid out narrow and then widened shows its long lines whole, not hard-wrapped at the old width |
| gioui.org | v0.10.4-0.20261005201158-fd8b878890c8 | app/os_wayland.go `dispatch`: a failed `wl_display_dispatch_pending` returns the display's error (`lastError`: the protocol error's interface, id and code, or the errno) | a display in error (the compositor dropped the client) no longer spins `wl_display_prepare_read` forever at full CPU: the window gets a `DestroyEvent` with the reason |
| gioui.org | v0.10.4-0.20261005201158-fd8b878890c8 | app/window.go `Window.Event`: a pending event (the platform's `DestroyEvent`) is delivered before the window is created again | a failure to reopen no longer replaces the error that closed the window |
| gioui.org | v0.10.4-0.20261005201158-fd8b878890c8 | app/window.go `processEvent`'s `DestroyEvent`: clears the stopped invalidate timer (`timer.quit`/`timer.update`) and the GPU error it reported (`gpuErr`) | a window opened again (after `eglSwapBuffers` failed, a monitor switched off) no longer freezes on its first animation, sending to the old timer goroutine forever; and a later close doesn't carry the old error back, reopening once more |
| gioui.org | v0.10.4-0.20261005201158-fd8b878890c8 | app/egl_wayland.go: the swap interval 0 is set in `Lock`, once the context is current (`vsyncOff`), not right after `CreateSurface`, where `eglSwapInterval` had no current context and did nothing | `eglSwapBuffers` no longer waits (interval 1, on NVIDIA) for a frame callback the compositor never sends a window it isn't showing (another workspace, the display off), which held the event loop and left pings unanswered ("not responding"); Gio's own frame callbacks pace the drawing as intended |
| gioui.org | v0.10.4-0.20261005201158-fd8b878890c8 | widget/editor.go `command`: Backspace and Delete with the word modifier skip the shortcut switch (`wordDelete`) | off macOS, where Ctrl is both the shortcut and the word modifier, Ctrl+Backspace and Ctrl+Delete delete a word again instead of being taken as an unknown shortcut and dropped |
| github.com/charmbracelet/x/vt | v0.1.0 | Home and End honor DECCKM like the arrows (`ESC O H`/`ESC O F`); mode 2026 is a known mode (DECRQM reports it) and `Synchronized` says an update is open (at most `SyncMax`). Tests in `key_test.go` | Home/End work in vim and less; renderers hold the last screen mid redraw, so Claude Code doesn't flicker |
| github.com/charmbracelet/x/vt | v0.1.0 | DECSTBM's bottom margin is clamped to the screen's height, as xterm does (`setVerticalMargins`). Test in `reflow_test.go` | a program that asks for a scroll region taller than the pane (sized for a bigger one) no longer crashes desk on its next line insert or delete |
| github.com/charmbracelet/x/vt | v0.1.0 | key_mod.go `modifiedKey`: the cursor, editing and function keys with Shift, Alt, Ctrl or Meta send xterm's sequences (`CSI 1;m A`, `CSI 3;m ~`…), and Ctrl+Backspace `^H`. Tests in `key_test.go` | Ctrl+← and Ctrl+→ move a word in the shell, Shift/Alt/Ctrl with the arrows, Home, End, Delete, PgUp/PgDn and F-keys reach programs instead of sending nothing |
| gioui.org | v0.10.4-0.20261005201158-fd8b878890c8 | io/key `NameInsert`; app/internal/xkb `convertKeysym` names `XKB_KEY_Insert` and the keypad's `XKB_KEY_KP_Insert`, app/os_windows.go `VK_INSERT` | the Insert key reaches desk: Shift+Insert pastes and Ctrl+Insert copies in a pane, Insert alone goes to the program |

Measured with `seq 1 300000` (1.9 MB) through `vt.Emulator`: 80 columns
7.0s → 1.0s, 200 columns 15.2s → 1.8s. Both modules' own test suites pass
with the patches.
